summary: Set updates validate numeric values, preserve undefined versus null patch semantics, return affected-row results and notify subscribers only after actual mutations.
Workout completion now guards service orchestration as well as persistence, preventing repeated or missing completions from advancing and saving program progression again.
Program creation binds and returns the same timestamp; regression tests cover stale mutations, notifications, validation and real progression orchestration through database seams.
Nine learning guides explain the actual repository/service flow with worked code, exercises, executable solution examples and exact original source snapshots.

limits: SQLite mutations remain synchronous because the app uses expo-sqlite synchronous APIs; callers still need UI-level error handling for thrown validation or database errors.
The repository does not add remote sync, authentication, conflict resolution, or a migration beyond the existing schema version.
The validation policy rejects negative values and non-finite numbers, but domain-specific coaching rules such as minimum load for every exercise remain outside this persistence layer.
Repository tests use a mocked database seam; no native SQLite/device/emulator run was performed.
No UI or release build verification is claimed.

Final suite uses one worker and a 30-second test bound. An earlier parallel run exceeded the default five-second bound in the existing deterministic plate-math property test; all assertions remain enabled.
